results.title: Two SPVM police officers arrested for racism and discrimination
results.description: Two former police officers have been arrested for racism and discrimination. Vincent Routhier, 24, and Zachary Belzil, 25, are both from station 39 in Montreal North, and crown prosecutors (DPCP) will now decide whether to file formal charges.

results.title: Peng Liyuan, spouses of APEC economies’ leaders visit cultural exhibition
results.description: SHENZHEN, Nov. 19 (Xinhua) — Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping, and spouses of leaders of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) economies visited a cultural exhibition on Thursday in Shenzhen, south China’s Guangdong Province. Peng warmly greeted the guests at the Shenzhen Bay Culture Square.
